source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Calculate total emissions for the pollutants being measured.
3. Identify excessive emissions.
4. Document the excessive industrial emissions in the air-quality report.
5. Complete the air-quality report.

**Note**: For a complete set of procedures for developing a standard air-quality report, see [Standard Air-Quality Report](/docs/air_quality_report.md).

## Step 1: Start with the monitoring records.

Because the required criteria pollutants and other air quality measurements are recorded in the monitoring records, you start to document excessive emissions there. You identify and note, in the monitoring records, which sources have produced high emissions.

**Note**: If you do not include sufficient information in the monitoring records, you risk not having all the data available to document excessive emissions when preparing the air-quality report.
